description: GSTIN (India GST number) validation: checks the 15-character format and the check character, and decodes the state, the embedded PAN and the type of PAN holder (company, individual, firm, trust and others). Format check only, not a GST portal registration lookup; the number is not stored. Useful for invoices, vendor onboarding and KYB forms for Indian businesses, and for catching typos. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).
name: india_gstin_validate
title: India GSTIN validator: check a GST number and decode state and PAN
